name: Arachnophobia
summary: A Horde bounty sends you west of Windshear Crag after Besseleth, the ancient spider haunting southern Stonetalon Mountains. Claim her fang for Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat, and the mountain roads may grow safer for travelers after dark.

sections.title: The Roadside Warning
sections.body: A weathered wanted poster warns travelers on the main road south of Windshear Crag of dangers to the west. Sishir Canyon and Webwinder Path are overrun by spiders. At the heart of the threat is Besseleth, an unusually large orange spider who commands her brood. After sunset, she ambushes anyone who strays from the path.

sections.title: The Earthbinder's Grievance
sections.body: Maggran Earthbinder, a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat, has posted the bounty on Besseleth. He nearly died in an earlier encounter, when her massive two-foot fang struck him. Maggran fought her off and limped to safety, but the wound still reminds him of the danger in the canyon shadows. He hopes an adventurer will bring him Besseleth's Fang and secure the passes, so trade and travel to Sun Rock Retreat can continue without fear.

faq.q: Where does the quest Arachnophobia begin?
faq.answer: Inspect the wanted poster on the west side of the main road in Stonetalon Mountains, just south of the entrance to Windshear Crag.
Besseleth lairs in Sishir Canyon, west of the roadside wanted poster. She roams the canyon's web-choked ground among her spider offspring.
Maggran Earthbinder is a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. He survived a venomous strike from Besseleth and posted the bounty to rid the canyon of her threat.

faq.q: Why is Besseleth such a threat to the region?
faq.answer: Besseleth is an exceptionally large, ruthless spider who stalks Sishir Canyon and nearby Webwinder Path. At night, she and her brood prey on travelers heading toward Sun Rock Retreat.

faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?
faq.answer: Slay Besseleth and take one of her enormous two-foot fangs. Bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat to claim the bounty.

faq.q: Is this quest available to the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. Arachnophobia is exclusive to the Horde, since Maggran Earthbinder at the Horde encampment of Sun Rock Retreat offers the bounty.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, clearing out Besseleth helps secure travel to Sun Rock Retreat and protect your foothold in central Stonetalon's crags.
As a tauren, you can help Maggran Earthbinder, who bears the painful scar of Besseleth's venom, in his hunt.
As a hunter, tracking a colossal spider through the shadowed crags of Sishir Canyon tests your skill at stalking in the mountains.
